sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Dạ answers the traveler question "Yes / polite acknowledgment" in small service and first-contact moments. Use this as a soft respectful acknowledgment when someone speaks to you first. This helps you respond respectfully even before you know the full answer. Its job is giving the other person a simple anchor rather than a long explanation.
